description: This file defines the CallsignTLS class, which manages thread-local storage for callsign strings, including guards for setting and resetting callsigns, and accessors for retrieving the current callsign. It also includes macros for conditional warning reporting related to callsign management.

classes.name: CallsignTLS
classes.description: Manages thread-local storage for callsign strings, providing static methods to get and set the callsign, and internal management of the callsign string.

classes.name: CallSignTLSGuard
classes.description: A guard class that sets a callsign upon construction and resets it upon destruction, ensuring proper scope-based management of callsign context.

methods.name: Callsign()
methods.description: Returns the current thread-local callsign string.
